nature: The 2026-10-24 BOARD-SCENES-BACKFILL scene (JOB BOARD-SCENES-BACKFILL, opened by Hadi's Action #34 — the board could only offer a YouTube embed his phone walled with a bot check). It is rebuilt from the piece's own production data — hidden_files/dir-series-v2/dir02-i2/ (the build's script_lines.json and its faster-whisper words.json) — with plates that are frames sampled from the finished draft render itself, because the piece's visuals are code-drawn animation (diranim.py) with no static plates. Faithful, not modernized: same images, same words, same order, same timings as the delivered video (the backfill's own DR-BACKFILL record, carried under in_scene_decisions). THE MP4 IS NOT RE-RENDERED FROM THIS SCENE — the render predates it; the scene restores the production file so the board plays the file itself. Between plate samples the motion is a crossfade, not the render's continuous animation (the backfill's own flag, DR-VISUALS).

in_scene_decisions.summary: The backfill account quoted in nature above: rebuilt 2026-10-24 from the piece's production data; faithful, not modernized; the MP4 is not re-rendered from this scene.

The scene restores the CURRENT draft version (the i2 locked lines) rather than the rebuild script, which rides Action #53 — in this package, the converted rebuild_script field. ANOMALY, carried verbatim and flagged, not corrected: the record's choice text describes 'close' splitting two ways (near in space / shut in state) — a polysemy the piece's own script never makes; dir-02's claim is closeness of meaning as distance. The text reads like a sibling piece's pattern carried into this record by the backfill job.

The visuals are code-drawn animation (diranim.py); in this scene the plates are frames of the finished draft render sampled at line starts and every ~2.6 s within a line (plus the container intro/outro cards), crossfaded — between samples, motion is a crossfade, not the render's continuous animation (the record's own flag).
